alt: 孩子低頭看著塌下的紙模型，朋友輕拍他的肩膀並遞上新紙張。
scene_prompt: 垂頭喪氣 means looking dejected and discouraged after disappointment. In a modern school art club, a child sits at a desk after a paper model has failed, shoulders slumped and head lowered, sadly looking at collapsed cardboard pieces. A kind classmate sits nearby offering help and a fresh sheet of paper. No humiliation or danger. Natural anatomy, hands attached and posture believable, model components rest on desk, chairs and table stable with coherent perspective.
